column7: 2026-11-06: Week token {WW} must match finance's Excel WEEKNUM(date, 2): weeks start Monday, week 1 = the week containing Jan 1 (NOT ISO 8601). User's decision, driven by matching finance spreadsheets. {DDD} (day-of-year, zero-padded to 3) is being added and reviewed first; {WW} builds on it.

2026-11-06: Status: {DDD} done (src, tests, d.ts, readme), uncommitted, awaiting user review. Next: {WW} built on DDD. My own plan (not user-confirmed): week = floor((DDD - 1 + mondayBasedWeekdayOfJan1) / 7) + 1; years can reach week 54, so add tests for that and for Jan 1 on each weekday.
